related_questions.question: How long does it take to get a waiver approved?

text_blocks.snippet: The time it takes to get a waiver approved varies significantly depending on the type of waiver, the agency handling it, and the complexity of the case. For example, the USCIS I-601A waiver for unlawful presence can take around 43.5 months on average, according to The Sedaghat Law Firm. Other waivers, like those related to military service or moral conduct, may have shorter processing times, potentially ranging from a few months to a year.
